      <title>Upgrade: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Back-End Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Canada (Remote)
</p>

<p><span><strong>About the Role:</strong><br><br>An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human.</span></p>
<p><span>We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. </span><span>You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics.</span></p>
<p><span>Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences.</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>Our Core Technologies</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools.</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>What You'll Do</strong></span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Journey creation:</strong> Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Optimization:</strong> Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Edge case handling: </strong>Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Containment:</strong> Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Product partnership:</strong> Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Safety and compliance:</strong> Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Handoffs:</strong> Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Testing:</strong> Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Monitoring: </strong>Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Voice tuning:</strong> Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Sierra relationship: </strong>Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>What We Look For:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>• 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles</span></p>
<p><span>• Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails</span></p>
<p><span>• Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates</span></p>
<p><span>• Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes</span></p>
<p><span>• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms.</span></p>
<p><span>• Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved</span></p>
<p><span>• Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response</span></p>
<p><span>• Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>Nice To Have:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>• Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect)</span></p>
<p><span>• Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling</span></p>
<p><span>• Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design</span></p>
<p><span>• Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2)</span></p>
<p><span>• Conversation design or UX writing experience</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>What We Offer You:&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<p><span>• Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan</span></p>
<p><span>• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>• Flexible PTO</span></p>
<p><span>• Opportunities for professional growth and development<br>• Paid parental leave</span></p>
<p><span>• Health &amp; wellness initiatives</span></p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - India
</p>

<h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2>
<p>The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering <em>outcomes</em>, not just a platform.</p>
<p>You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."</p>
<h2><strong>Role Description</strong></h2>
<p>As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.</p>
<p>You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.</p>
<p>This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.</p>
<h2><strong>The impact you will have</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>C-Suite Scoping &amp; Value Definition:</strong> Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.</li>
<li><strong>End-to-End Product Ownership:</strong> Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.</li>
<li><strong>Technical Solution Leadership</strong><strong> &amp; Delivery:</strong> Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.</li>
<li><strong>Solution Launch &amp; Landing:</strong> Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.</li>
<li><strong>Strategic Handoff &amp; Growth:</strong> Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>What we look for</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Executive Presence &amp; Communication:</strong> You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.</li>
<li><strong>Product Judgment &amp; Delivery:</strong> You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.</li>
<li><strong>Technical Fluency &amp; Architecture Judgment:</strong> You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.</li>
<li><strong>Hands-on Technical Ability:</strong> You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.</li>
<li><strong>Relevant Experience:</strong> Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p>
